The '''Coruscant Wildlife Management Department''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] organization on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was responsible for the control of [[Coruscani ogre]]s.

==History==
During the last years of the Republic, the ambitious [[Melen Toobo]] became head of the department. He wanted to domesticate some of the ogres, so as to put them to productive use. To do this, he had them fitted with extensive [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] that allowed the ogres to be used as cheap and disposable alternatives to [[Droid/Legends|droid]] laborers.

When the Republic underwent the transition into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the department underwent an audit and the Imperials learned about the project. The Empire planned to use the ogres as soldiers.
